title.zh: SoFi, Kraken tie up as crypto and banking push into each other's turf
title.en: SoFi, Kraken tie up as crypto and banking push into each other's turf

current_state.zh: SoFi与Kraken宣布合作，由Kraken母公司Payward上市SoFiUSD，接入24/7结算网络，并通过Kraken Prime提供数字资产流动性，体现银行与加密服务融合。
current_state.en: SoFi and Kraken announce a partnership where Kraken parent Payward lists SoFiUSD, connects to SoFi's 24/7 settlement network, and provides digital asset liquidity via Kraken Prime, signaling convergence between banking and crypto services.

updates.what_changed_en: Kraken parent Payward partners with SoFi to list SoFiUSD, connect to SoFi's 24/7 settlement network, and provide digital asset liquidity via Kraken Prime.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Kraken parent Payward partners with SoFi to list SoFiUSD, connect to SoFi's 24/7 settlement network, and provide digital asset liquidity via Kraken Prime.
updates.background_zh: Kraken是最早的加密货币交易所之一，2011年在母公司Payward下创立，并于2013年正式上线运营。SoFi是一家数字金融服务公司，拥有约1580万会员，其App此前已提供加密货币交易；SoFi于2025年12月宣布推出SoFiUSD，随后将该稳定币接入其银行平台。SoFi Exchange Network（SEN）是SoFi提供的7×24小时美元结算网络，旨在让合作平台在传统银行营业时间之外也能完成美元清算与结算。
updates.background_en: Kraken is one of the oldest cryptocurrency exchanges, co-founded in 2011 under parent company Payward and publicly launched in 2013. SoFi is a digital financial services company with about 15.8 million members that already offers crypto trading in its app; SoFi announced SoFiUSD in December 2025 and later made it available on its banking platform. The SoFi Exchange Network (SEN) is SoFi’s 24/7 dollar settlement network, designed to let participating platforms clear and settle US dollars outside traditional banking hours.
updates.market_impact_zh: 主要传导渠道在于稳定币分发与结算基础设施：SoFiUSD上线Kraken以及Payward接入SEN，有望扩大机构客户对银行发行稳定币的使用，并支持7×24小时美元结算，可能影响市场对稳定币出入金通道及结算网络的选择。这类影响属于市场运行结构层面，不应据此推断任何资产的具体价格方向。
updates.market_impact_en: The main transmission channel is stablecoin distribution and settlement infrastructure: listing SoFiUSD on Kraken and connecting Payward to SEN broadens bank-issued stablecoin access for institutional clients and supports around-the-clock dollar settlement, which could influence demand for stablecoin-based on/off ramps and the competitive positioning of settlement networks. These are operational market-structure effects and imply no specific directional move for any asset.
